newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline dips $2, barges trade $202 and $204.5.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline dips $2, barges trade $202 and $204.5.

text.p: NWE gasoline slipped $2 a tonne on Wednesday with barge trade at $202 and $204 for premium barges, dealers said.
Running Rotterdam refinery barges talked $204.75 with Amsterdam Rotterdam loading at $204.
Swaps slipped to $203 for June and $194.50 for July but crack spreads against Brent were unchanged at $4.10 a barrel and $3.05 for the third and fourth quarters this year.
Dealers said bearish API figures had helped pushed prices lower in Europe with both higher stocks and higher refinery runs reported in the United States.
Speculation about a possible UK tax hike on July 2 continued unabated and helped keep the backwardation steep.
